title: CTGAN
summary: A GAN-based synthetic tabular data generator implementing the NeurIPS paper 'Modeling Tabular data using Conditional GAN'. This repository is a direct fork of sdv-dev/CTGAN (via an intermediate fork), vendoring the CTGANSynthesizer source in-tree with only minor compatibility updates and no core algorithm changes.
